diagnosis.symptom: The installed Game Provider repeatedly changed boot identity and appeared not to start.
diagnosis.root_cause: The profile supervisor still probed the removed Game Provider /health endpoint. The canonical /observation endpoint was healthy, but each failed legacy probe caused the supervisor to restart the process.
diagnosis.resolution: Publish exact producer identity in /observation and use that single contract in supervisor, stop and deploy paths. Removed encountered Playnite aliases and legacy health-field handling.

validation.note: One first build attempt saw a transient existing DPAPI path-with-spaces test failure. The targeted test passed three consecutive reruns, and the next full provider run passed 271/271. The fully tested build then reached only the network-gated Legendary fetch; final packaging reused that exact source with SkipTests and network access.
